written: 2026-10-18, before the first round-2 E2 run; maps each round-2 held-out question (evals/repo_questions/round2/*.json, not modified) to investigate() supported-shape queries. The raw question is also tried first and used if investigate supports it. Symbol names are taken as the question words them (no qualname completion by hand).
facts_rule: RepoFindings.facts of the used investigate calls (merged in plan order, later keys do not overwrite earlier ones) are compared with expected_facts key by key; the answer is correct iff every expected key matches. Missing key = mismatch; extra returned keys are ignored. Per key: `symbol` and other dotted names match when equal or when the returned name ends with '.' + expected (expected may be a short name such as Signer.unsign); `fix_commit`/`removing_commit`/sha strings match when one is a prefix of the other (>= 7 hex); other strings exact and case-sensitive (revisions compared as given, e.g. 'v1.2.0'); numbers and booleans by ==; `value` compared after converting tuples to lists; list fields are compared as SETS (both directions: every expected item matches a distinct-or-shared returned item and every returned item matches some expected item), string items by the dotted-name rule, dict items when every expected key of the item matches the returned item's key by these rules (extra returned item keys ignored); keys ending in `_include` are subset checks (every expected item matches some returned item) against the returned list named by the prefix (`resolved_targets_include` -> returned `targets` without external entries, falling back to `resolved_targets`).
